subject.title: [Bug]: Managed Memory Dreaming Promotion cron silently NO_REPLY since 2026-05-09 (jobs.json lastRun stays null)

question: Should managed Memory Dreaming per-workspace failures or no-op sweeps make the outer cron run degraded/error, or should cron stay ok with separate doctor/UI diagnostics?
rationale: Current source can keep cron green while memory-core logs failed workspaces, and changing that affects retry/backoff/failure-alert semantics rather than a purely mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Promote failures to cron diagnostics
options.body: Treat failed or no-op managed Dreaming sweeps as degraded/error in the outer cron result or diagnostics so operators can see the failure without log spelunking.

options.title: Keep cron ok, add doctor/UI visibility
options.body: Leave cron status quiet for maintenance sweeps but add explicit doctor or Dreams UI warnings for stale diary and failed workspace counts.

options.title: Close after live non-repro proof
options.body: Close only if a current-release deployment proves managed Dreaming updates SQLite cron state and diary artifacts without stale no-op behavior.

recommendation.title: Promote failures to cron diagnostics
recommendation.body: Treat failed or no-op managed Dreaming sweeps as degraded/error in the outer cron result or diagnostics so operators can see the failure without log spelunking.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest current-main owner signal for the managed Dreaming cron and doctor migration surfaces that would need the status contract change.
